key: Life's been so busy since the restoration!
en: Life's been so busy since the restoration!
ja: 復興が始まってから、生活がめちゃくちゃ忙しくて!

key: I'm scheduled to volunteer at the Slums tonight, but I still have practice and exams to study for!
en: I'm scheduled to volunteer at the Slums tonight, but I still have practice and exams to study for!
ja: 今夜はスラムでボランティアの予定なのに、部活の練習も試験勉強もまだ残ってる!

key: How is one person supposed to handle all of this!?
en: How is one person supposed to handle all of this!?
ja: これ全部、一人でどうやってこなせっていうの!?

key: God, I need to slow down.
en: God, I need to slow down.
ja: ああ、もう少しペースを落とさなきゃ。

key: I got a job at SOLICE but how anyone balances work, school and hobbies is beyond me.
en: I got a job at SOLICE but how anyone balances work, school and hobbies is beyond me.
ja: SOLICEで仕事を始めたけど、仕事と学校と趣味をどうやって両立させてるのか、さっぱりわからない。

key: And you can't really have one without the others! Uggh!
en: And you can't really have one without the others!  Uggh!
ja: どれか一つが欠けても駄目なんだから! もう!

key: I should be safe here, right?
en: I should be safe here, right?

key: I was running from some strange guy.
en: I was running from some strange guy.
ja: 変な男から逃げてきたの。

key: I think I lost him, but I kinda don't wanna go home right now in case I run into him again.
en: I think I lost him, but I kinda don't wanna go home right now in case I run into him again.
ja: まけたとは思うけど、また会うといけないから、今は家に帰りたくない気分。

key: I wonder if there's somewhere else near here that I could go.
en: I wonder if there's somewhere else near here that I could go.
ja: このあたりに、どこか他に行けるところないかしら。

key: Oh, the Coral Gym is open for help?
en: Oh, the Coral Gym is open for help?
ja: あ、コーラルジムで手伝いを募集してるの?

key: Hmm, okay! Volunteering will be a good way to keep myself busy while I lay low. I'll go help out!
en: Hmm, okay! Volunteering will be a good way to keep myself busy while I lay low. I'll go help out!
ja: うん、決めた! しばらく身を潜めながら、ボランティアで忙しくしてるのもいいかも。手伝いに行くわ!
